name: Rabble Mawb
description: These cat-sized balls of hair, limbs, and teeth travel in a “mawb” of a dozen.

abilities.name: Horde (1d4+1)
abilities.description: When the Rabble Mawb has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Come Back Worse
abilities.description: When the Rabble Mawb is defeated, you can spend a Fear to bring it back to life, clearing all HP and Stress. The Rabble Mawb gains a bonus to all rolls equal to the number of times this feature has been used by this Rabble Mawb.
